comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null/0 rules, but the construct differs. Left requires a specific, verifiable procedural example: a concrete description of an actual process, rule, protocol or practice. Right accepts any specific concrete example or real-world instance, including a person, event, place, product, study or situation. Right is much broader, and procedural examples are only a narrow subtype of it. Left also excludes quoted OP text, which right doesn't state.
